name: Haven 0.11.0
body:
## Changelog
- Synced with the latest upstream Element (64 commits)
- Play webxdc games (`.xdc` files) right where they're posted, in rooms and in Social: tap the game's cartridge to play it in the timeline, pop it out into a window of its own, or play along with others in the room. Progress is kept in your account, with a Save button to save it straight away
- Play Flash games (`.swf` files) the same way, with the built-in Ruffle player. Flash saves are kept every few seconds and when you close a game
- Games in the web app run in a sandbox bundled with Haven, with no setup needed. Hosts who want games to have pages of their own can set up a separate sandbox (`haven.webxdc_sandbox_url`, see docs/configure.md)
- Embed YouTube, Twitch, X and direct media links in the timeline and in Social
- Edit Social posts, and autocomplete users and rooms in Social's composers, sent as pills
- Pop widgets out into a window of their own that stays connected to Haven, and open matrix.to links from widgets inside the app
- Widen Social posts with their media at full width, and count only a post's direct replies
- Keep read threads read when their read receipt's event isn't loaded
- Keep a jumped-to message in place while newer messages load below it
- Fixed more genuine bridged reposts being flagged as possible forgeries
- Fixed the Social composer's caret drifting away from the text, and the Feed showing nothing when the newest post was deleted
- The Windows app now includes encrypted message search

## Building with Flash support
Every download here includes Ruffle 0.7.1 for Flash games. To build it yourself, set `HAVEN_RUFFLE=latest` (or a version, or a path to your own copy of Ruffle) when running `./scripts/setup.sh`. See docs/building.md.

## Downloads
- **Web**: `haven-v0.11.0.tar.gz` - static build, host it yourself
- **Linux**: `Haven-0.11.0.AppImage`, `haven-desktop_0.11.0_amd64.deb`, `haven-desktop-0.11.0.pacman`, or `haven-desktop-0.11.0.flatpak`
- **Windows**: `Haven Setup 0.11.0.exe`

See the README for build-from-source instructions.

name: Haven 0.10.0
body:
## Changelog
- Synced with the latest upstream Element (211 commits)
- Added a Search section to Social with People, Groups and Posts tabs: find people (with a Follow or Request Follow button for their profile), browse group directories on any homeserver, and search posts with the matching text highlighted
- Added a Mutual Rooms button to the user panel, with a searchable list of the rooms you share
- Show stickers in Social, and show HEIC images by converting them to JPEG in the client
- Let Add to Pack set the shortcode, description and usage, added it to the reactions dialog, and moved pack Copy and Delete into a menu with a delete confirmation
- Show a user's profile name and avatar in pills and the user panel when the room has none, and hide the verification spinner for users with no devices
- Hide the room list's space banner on the space's home page, and keep a post's protocol badge next to the end of a wrapped display name
- Let videos from authenticated media seek, and retry failed images for longer with a clickable retry
- Fixed the Social feed scrolling or jumping by itself while posts load, at the top, and when pressing Repost
- Keep a Social composer's draft and the scroll position when navigating away and back, and make Back from a post opened by link return to where it was opened
- Fixed genuine bridged reposts being flagged as possible forgeries, including over paragraph spacing
- Load a post's full set of reactions when opening it, and keep line breaks in profile and group bios
- Fixed edited messages with code blocks overflowing the timeline, and Jump to bottom needing two clicks
- The Flatpak now builds with pnpm 12 and builds Element Call's new embedded component from source

## Downloads
- **Web**: `haven-v0.10.0.tar.gz` - static build, host it yourself
- **Linux**: `Haven-0.10.0.AppImage`, `haven-desktop_0.10.0_amd64.deb`, `haven-desktop-0.10.0.pacman`, or `haven-desktop-0.10.0.flatpak`
- **Windows**: `Haven Setup 0.10.0.exe`

See the README for build-from-source instructions.

name: Haven 0.9.0
body:
## Changelog
- Synced with the latest upstream Element (132 commits, up to v1.12.28)
- Added a "Reaction Pill Size" appearance setting
- Added an encryption toggle to the pre-send new-DM screen
- Added gun emoji style and skin tone settings (now dropdowns, matching the other picker settings)
- Made the revolver the default gun emoji and redrew the pistol emoji as a real pistol instead of a water pistol
- Support custom emoji in the Social post composer, and open a custom emoji's image directly from its reaction hover tooltip
- Redesigned the bulk-redact dialog with Recent/Custom modes and pagination, and added a "Remove Messages" option for your own messages with a message-count limit
- Show a repost of a repost as a nested card instead of misattributing it, and fixed a false-positive repost forgery flag on plain-text posts
- Fixed reply relation getting lost when uploading a file inside a thread, and fixed repost card navigation from a post's own dedicated page
- Fixed encrypted videos failing to start playback when clicked before decryption had finished
- Fixed collapsed room-list sections showing their rooms again after switching apps
- Fixed invisible text and a double resize handle in the Social reply composer, and fixed the emoji/slash-command autocomplete clipping inside modals
- Fixed the timeline scrolling away from a highlighted event as media loads in, and a composer caret drift regression
- Fixed a solid-red mention highlight bug in the Threads list
- Fixed matrix-seshat (local encrypted-room message search) breaking in the Flatpak build after upstream dropped the old hak-based build - now built from source directly, verified working
- Fixed the AppImage's libfuse2 dependency and added delta-update (zsync) support so it can update itself in place
- Fixed the unbranded build breaking after an upstream sync - the branding revert now patches out just the branding lines instead of reverting whole files to a year-old commit
- Fixed missing launcher icon in the deb/pacman builds and the app icon's background lighting to match the original

## Downloads
- **Web**: `haven-v0.9.0.tar.gz` - static build, host it yourself
- **Linux**: `Haven-0.9.0.AppImage`, `haven-desktop_0.9.0_amd64.deb`, `haven-desktop-0.9.0.pacman`, or `haven-desktop-0.9.2.flatpak`
- **Windows**: `Haven Setup 0.9.0.exe`

See the README for build-from-source instructions.

name: Haven 0.8.0
body:
## Changelog
- Synced with the latest upstream Element (~160 commits)
- Added a pacman package for Arch Linux, alongside the existing AppImage, .deb, and Flatpak builds
- Fixed matrix-seshat (local encrypted-room message search) never actually working in the AppImage, .deb, pacman, or Flatpak builds - now built from source and verified working in all of them
- Added a repost/reply source verification badge showing whether a repost's content actually matches the original post, and fixed several cases where it falsely flagged genuine reposts (bridged content, benign field differences) as forgeries
- Added right-click on a Social reaction pill to open the reactions dialog
- Show MSC4144 per-message profiles in the room timeline and Social
- Added a "Copy Pack" option and guarded the settings dialog from closing with unsaved custom emoji/sticker pack edits
- Fixed the emoji picker's Enter key, layout, and blurry pack image thumbnails
- Increased reaction pill and tooltip sizes
- Moved "View Devices" into the developer-mode button list and show it on your own profile too
- Fixed the Share dialog freezing under some browsers' canvas privacy protections
- Fixed SSO login using the wrong protocol on desktop
- Auto-increment the filename instead of prompting to overwrite when saving an image

## Downloads
- **Web**: `haven-v0.8.0.tar.gz` - static build, host it yourself
- **Linux**: `Haven-0.8.0.AppImage`, `haven-desktop_0.8.0_amd64.deb`, `haven-desktop-0.8.0.pacman`, or `software.haven.HavenDesktop-0.8.0.flatpak`

name: Haven 0.7.0

- Added Flatpak packaging (`software.haven.HavenDesktop`)
- Fixed the AppImage fully closing with nothing replacing it after "Remove this device" (or any other clear-data-and-relaunch flow)
- Fixed the "unsupported keyring" dialog reappearing on every launch after logging out, on systems with no supported keyring backend
- Fixed stale scroll position and wrong-profile landing when clicking usernames in Social, and HTML bio rendering
- Fixed emoji picker tiles not filling their full clickable area
- Fixed Enter in the emoji reaction picker preferring a freeform reaction over a real highlighted match
- Fixed the custom emoji/sticker picker loading full-resolution images instead of thumbnails
- Fixed a double scrollbar in the device list dialog
- Fixed the room list's blurred-avatar backdrop being silently dropped from release builds
- Fixed Alt+Up/Down room navigation when no room is currently selected
- Fixed a crash from per-section room-list settings on a missing/incomplete settings object
- Fixed the Forward dialog's Body/attachment toggles not being clickable across their full pill
- Fixed "Create New Pack" text wrapping and spacing in the emoji/sticker picker
- Fixed /me messages with a mention pill wrapping onto a second line
- Fixed unbranded web builds showing a generic version string instead of the real one

name: Haven 0.6.0
body:
## Changelog
- Synced with upstream Element Web, including its rewritten emoji/sticker picker (ported custom-pack reactions and sticker mode onto the new implementation)
- Updated MSC4501 support for the latest spec changes: profile_room is now a {room_id, via} block instead of a flat profile_room_id string, and relates_to blocks on reposts/replies now carry via routing hints too
- Fixed the legacy room list's breadcrumbs never visually reordering as you navigate
- Fixed the top-left avatar rendering non-square and cropped
- Fixed a stray horizontal scrollbar in the room list
- Removed the public-room globe badge from the room list
- Fixed stickers rendering at the wrong (emoji) size in the picker
- Fixed greentext not rendering for media captions or the Post dialog
- Fixed greentext rendering collapsing fenced code blocks to a single line
- Fixed clicking around a video post not opening its thread
- Fixed a matrix.to post link not reopening on a second click
- Fixed replies not loading when opening a post via a cross-room repost/reply card
- Retained Social's scroll position across thread views and Chat/Social switches
- Fixed Social profile scrolling back up while content loads
- Fixed chat effects not firing when a room's notification settings don't count a message as unread
- Patched compound-web's Tooltip to stop a background performance drain while closed
- Fixed fresh git clones failing to build

- Fixed sticker replies losing their reply context, and a pill click kicking you out of the room
- Fixed reaction pill emoji clipped on the left edge
- Fixed Social feed scroll jumping while images below the fold load
- Fixed Alt+Up/Down room list highlight flickering backward
- Fixed J/K hijacking real typing in text inputs elsewhere in the UI

name: Haven 0.4.0
body:
## Changelog
- Added MSC4221 space/room banners: a room or space banner now shows behind its avatar on a space's home page and in the room list header when a space with one is selected, alongside the existing room banner support in the room header. Settable from space/room settings using the same banner upload UI as before, with a new "Banners" section in Settings > Appearance to turn either display off
- Added MSC4427 profile banners: settable from user settings next to your avatar, shown on the right panel wherever user banners already appear, taking priority over the older profile-room-based fallback
- The room list header now shows the active space's icon next to its name when the spaces bar itself is hidden
- Added a manage-pack gear icon to the emoji/sticker picker, jumping straight to that pack's management view in room settings
- Added drag-to-reorder for rooms and subspaces within a space
- Fixed clicking the checkboxes in the space room list not actually selecting the room
- Fixed Space Home not exiting a forced room timeline after using "See room timeline"
- Fixed raw HTML tags showing up in room topics in the room header instead of being rendered
- Tightened room list item padding to show a bit more of the room name and message preview before truncating

name: Haven 0.3.5
body:
## Changelog
- Synced with upstream element-web, bringing in ~199 commits including a full MVVM rewrite of the room list, a sliding-sync-native pagination model, and a dependency-injection refactor of core stores - every Haven customization (MSC2545 image packs, MSC4459 provenance, MSC4501 Social profile rooms, MSC4503 external handles, apps-framework wording) ported forward through the merge, and four Social Feed reliability/performance bugs found while testing it got fixed along the way
- The old (pre-MVVM) room list is back as an opt-in labs flag for anyone not ready to move to the new one yet, including the Favourites/People meta-spaces and breadcrumbs it depends on - the new room list stays the default
- Create Profile/Group now default to Ask to Join and gain an "Allow anyone to post" toggle (off by default); the Social member list gains a "Trusted" tag for members who can post without being a Creator/Admin/Moderator
- Added an opt-out setting for attaching MSC4459 provenance metadata to outgoing custom emoji/stickers/reactions
- Room list header: the space menu moved from a chevron next to the space name to an overflow ("...") button aligned with Expand/Collapse and "+"; when the spaces bar is off, the space name itself now opens a scrollable switcher listing every space with its unread indicators
- Fixed the room list briefly flickering room positions when switching rooms
- Fixed login silently creating a new identity instead of restoring an account that had valid keys backed up but no published public cross-signing keys
- Fixed the Unreads filter missing plain-activity unread rooms and instantly dropping the open room from the list the moment it was read
- Fixed Like/Reply being permanently disabled on thread ancestor post tiles in Social
- Fixed the emoji/sticker picker crashing when deleting search text with a pack category selected, and added an empty state to the Stickers tab
- Fixed Help & About showing only the bare release number instead of Haven's full version string (including the pinned Element version) on desktop builds

## Downloads
- **Web**: `haven-v0.3.5+element-v1.12.23-188-gdd7c9ed6fe.tar.gz` - static build, host it yourself
- **Linux**: `Haven-0.3.5.AppImage` or `haven-desktop_0.3.5_amd64.deb`
- **Windows**: `Haven Setup 0.3.5.exe`

See the README for build-from-source instructions.

name: Haven 0.3.0
body:
## Changelog
- Custom emoji sent in messages, reactions, and stickers now reference the pack's source room (MSC4459), with a "Find Pack" option to locate, preview, or favourite it from any message that used it
- Image packs are now full MSC2545 (Image Packs), including read-only compatibility for the older MSC3639 room/event types
- Image pack settings: image lists are now scrollable and searchable, and pack/image boxes are consistently sized between room and user settings
- Room list sections (Favourites, Low Priority, Chats, and custom sections) each now have their own Sort and Appearance options, available from that section's own "..." menu or by right-clicking the section header directly
- Added the "Settings" option back to the room right-click menu in the new room list
- Custom images always render in reactions now, no longer a labs-only option
- The room topic now shows under the room name in the room header, matching old Element
- Fixed the Attachment button on Social posts sending the post instead of opening the upload menu
- Fixed a post's room-name badge not opening that room's Social page on click
- Added Shift+Click on a post's room-name badge to open the regular chat view instead
- Reply/comment text now goes through the same markdown pipeline as posts, and reply chains connect with the same thread line as their ancestors, including nested replies

## Downloads
- **Web**: `haven-0.3.0.tar.gz` - static build, host it yourself
- **Linux**: `Haven-0.3.0.AppImage` or `haven-desktop_0.3.0_amd64.deb`
- **Windows**: `Haven Setup 0.3.0.exe`

See the README for build-from-source instructions.

name: Haven 0.2.0
body:
## Changelog
- Posts on Social can now attach a file (image, video, or other) via the paperclip button, paste, or drag-and-drop - staged in a preview shelf and only actually uploaded once the post is sent
- The small protocol icon next to a poster's name (e.g. a linked Fediverse handle) now comes from their account profile instead of needing to be stamped on every individual post
- Support for MSC4501 body/formatted_body override fields on Social posts
- Fixed Social feed/thread ordering for events with identical backfilled timestamps
- Fixed stale reaction badges when re-focusing a thread's own posts
- Fixed Home button selection, Ctrl-K Social routing, and profile navigation bugs
- Fixed thread view scroll position and missing nested replies
- Inline images now retry a few times before showing a permanent load error

- **Linux**: `Haven-0.2.0.AppImage` or `haven-desktop_0.2.0_amd64.deb`
- **Windows**: `Haven Setup 0.2.0.exe`

See the README for build-from-source instructions.
